# Theme scope. A jurisdiction location borders land owned by a country that is neither Byzantium nor in its bloc.
oe_ti_borders_foreign = {
    any_owned_foreign_building_location = {
        owner ?= c:BYZ
        is_border = yes
        any_neighbor_location = { owner ?= { NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}

# Theme scope. Came to the empire by conquest or charter: status 2, 3 or 4 and not core-origin.

    oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
    OR = { oe_ts_frontier = yes oe_ts_exarch = yes oe_ts_charter = yes }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_ti_origin_core }
}
# Theme scope. Approximation of 'majority of the population': the seat's dominant culture or religion.
oe_ti_law_culture_ok = {
    capital ?= {
        OR = {
            dominant_culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
            dominant_religion ?= { this = religion:orthodox }
        }
    }
}

    oe_ti_law_basic = yes
